name: prism
description: Prism — a production-grade async job platform (Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @prism/contracts && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @prism/api && npm run build -w @prism/worker && npm run build -w @prism/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && npm run prisma:generate && concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run prisma:generate && npm run typecheck -w @prism/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @prism/api && npm run typecheck -w @prism/worker && npm run typecheck -w @prism/web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run prisma:generate && npm run test -w @prism/api && npm run test -w @prism/worker
